quirks: inputSchema was null in registry; the body requires BOTH image_url and image_type — omitting image_type returns a 400 'Validation failed' (and you are still charged $0.01).
image_type is a free-text string; 'xray' was accepted. Use a modality string like 'xray' or 'mri'.
Pays $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call even on validation failures — always include image_type to avoid a wasted charge.
Synchronous: full diagnostic result returns inline in the 200 body, no polling.
Output includes a disclaimer that this is AI preliminary screening, not a formal diagnosis.
usage.guide: POST a JSON body to https://gg402.vercel.app/medical_image_analyzer with both image_url (a publicly fetchable image URL) and image_type (a modality string such as 'xray' or 'mri'). Payment is $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. CRITICAL: image_type is required even though it is not in any published schema — omitting it returns a 400 but still charges you. Read the result from the 200 JSON body: body.anomalies_detected is an array of {anomaly, confidence, location} and body.diagnostic_insights is a prose radiology-style summary. It is synchronous; no polling needed.
